An '''uprising''' of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] occurred in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Subjugation of Naboo]]. Having sensed a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] provoked by a [[Marauding Dark Jedi|band]] of Dark [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], a [[Jedi Consular]] named [[Jorus C'baoth]] intervened with a group of fellow [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] and brought the insurrection to an end. The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was liberated from the scourge of the Dark Jedi, and, as a consequence of his victory, C'baoth awarded himself the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. The memory of that incident was later conflated with a similar [[Bpfassh Uprising|crisis]], which involved [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and occurred at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. That confusion even made its way into the historical records of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] that were retrieved by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], founder of the [[New Jedi Order]], more than forty years later.

==The uprising==
[[File:Elrood_Sector.png|thumb|left|160px|The Elrood sector, where the uprising took place]]
A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Subjugation of Naboo]]<ref name="RPGRCR" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Marauding Dark Jedi|band]] of marauding [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] sowed terror throughout the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Around the same [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Jedi Consular]] named [[Jorus C'baoth]] left his position as [[Jedi Ambassador|advisor]] to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Senator/Legends|representative]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. Having felt a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]], which the Dark [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had caused, C'baoth led a strike team of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] into the Elrood [[Sector/Legends|sector]] to eliminate the threat they posed. The marauding Dark Jedi were ultimately defeated, and peace was restored in the sector.<ref name="RPGRCR" />

==Aftermath==
As the architect of the Jedi victory against the uprising, C'baoth assumed the title of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]],<ref name="RPGRCR" /> which was a quite unorthodox move. In the normal course, a Jedi was formally promoted to the rank of Master by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] after successfully [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] several [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] into Knights and having them pass their [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]].<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> The members of the High Council, however, were so content with the Dark Jedi's defeat that they did not oppose C'baoth's self-appointment.<ref name="RPGRCR" />

Many years later, legend had distorted truth.<ref name="CSWEBpf">{{CSWECite|I|90|Bpfassh}}</ref> The account of the Elrood events was conflated with that of [[Bpfassh Uprising|another]] Dark Jedi insurrection, which occurred in the [[Bpfassh system/Legends|Bpfassh system]] following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and involved [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="CSWEDag">{{CSWECite|I|161|Dagobah}}</ref> Indeed, when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the first of a [[New Jedi Order|new generation]] of Jedi, searched the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] records on Jorus C'baoth<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he read that the late Master was a member of the Jedi force assembled to oppose the Dark Jedi insurrection on [[Bpfassh]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Member of the Jedi force assembled to oppose the Dark Jedi insurrection on Bpfassh 7\77 to 1\74 PE.|Galactic Senate records on Jorus C'baoth, as shown in ''Dark Force Rising''|<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />}}
In [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[1992]] novel ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'', the second entry in [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''The Thrawn Trilogy'']], Jorus C'baoth was credited with defeating a Dark Jedi insurrection on Bpfassh between the years 77 and 74 "Pre-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]" (P.E.). The book also mentioned C'baoth assumed the title of Jedi Master that same year.<ref name="Dark Force Rising" /> However, Zahn had based his dating on when he believed the Clone Wars had happened. By then, the definitive chronology of the Clone Wars had not yet been established, and ''[[Star Wars]]'' authors were told that it had taken place [[35 BBY/Legends|thirty-five years]] before [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. With the release of the [[prequel trilogy]] between [[1999]] and [[2005]], it was revealed that the conflict ended only sixteen years later, thus rendering all the dates featured in the ''Thrawn Trilogy'' inaccurate.<ref name="HE20">''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''</ref>

In [[2008]], ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' credited Yoda with opposing the Bpfasshi darksiders,<ref name="CSWEDag">{{CSWECite|I|161|Dagobah}}</ref> treating C'baoth's involvement in quelling an insurrection as a legend.<ref name="CSWEBpf" /> However, the [[2002]] sourcebook ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]'' had already established its own [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] by stating C'baoth had settled a Dark Jedi insurrection in the Elrood sector, a few years before the Battle of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="RPGRCR" /> The present article considers both accounts [[canon]], since they do not contradict each other.
